s.note: Devilled eggs piped high and dusted with paprika.
s.how: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, then cool in iced water. Peel and halve the eggs and mash the yolks with the mayo, mustard, vinegar and salt. Pipe or spoon back into the whites, dust with paprika and scatter with chives.

s.n: Square-peg ravioli in a round bowl
s.note: Ricotta ravioli in hot parmesan broth.
s.how: Simmer the stock with the parmesan and garlic for 10 minutes, then fish out the rind. Drop in the ravioli and cook until they float. Ladle into round bowls, add a squeeze of lemon, oil, basil and grated parmesan.

m.note: Texas brisket, sliced thick with pickles and white bread.
m.how: Rub the brisket all over with the pepper, salt, paprika and garlic powder. Sit it fat side up in a roasting tin, pour the stock around, cover tightly with foil and cook at 140C. Uncover and roast at 200C until the bark darkens. Rest for 20 minutes, then slice across the grain. Serve with white bread, pickles, onion and barbecue sauce.

m.note: Chicken and leek under a golden puff lid, hot enough for a freezing lifeboat.
m.how: Brown the chicken in the butter, then add the leek and carrot and cook until soft. Stir in the flour, then the stock and cream, and simmer until thick. Stir in the peas, season and spoon into 4 pie dishes. Top with pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden.

w.note: Vanilla custard under a scorched sugar crust.
w.how: Warm the cream with the vanilla seeds and pod until steaming, then take off the heat. Whisk the yolks and 80g sugar, then whisk in the cream and strain into 4 ramekins. Bake in a water bath at 150C until just set with a wobble, then chill. Sprinkle each with sugar and scorch with a blowtorch or under a hot grill until dark amber.
shop: 80g caster sugar, plus 4 tbsp for the tops@Pantry

d.note: Brut sparkling with a sugar cube and bitters.
d.how: Drop a sugar cube into each of 4 flutes and shake a dash of bitters onto each. Top slowly with the cold sparkling and add a twist of orange peel.
